channel.title: GitScars Field Notes
channel.description: Essays on software regressions, attention budgets in AI coding assistants, and the architecture of deterministic failure memory.

item.title: Prompt Budgets: Scaling Agent Retrieval from 871 to 133 Tokens
item.description: How multi-signal anchor scoring and hard token budget caps eliminate attention dilution in Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf.

item.title: Automating Regression Memory: From Git Blame to AST Guardrails
item.description: Why manual documentation fails in fast-moving teams, and how git-scars harvest mines historical bug fixes into reviewable drafts.

item.title: The Myth of the Monolithic AGENTS.md
item.description: Why stuffing hundreds of rules into global prompt files dilutes model attention and provides zero protection when code refactors.

item.title: Why Vector Memory Hallucinates Without AST Proof
item.description: Semantic similarity search is fundamentally the wrong paradigm for regression prevention in production codebases.

item.title: The Fail-to-Pass Verification Invariant
item.description: Why unverified failure advice is toxic to codebases, and how scrubbed test environments guarantee reproduction.
